NuclearBoundR88G.convolution_after_projection_split.{u_1} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
  (A P : E →L[ℂ] E) : A.comp P = P.comp (A.comp P) + (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - P).comp (A.comp P)
NuclearBoundR88G.lifted_vector_norm_split.{u_1} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
  (A P : E →L[ℂ] E) (u : E) : ‖A u‖ ≤ ‖P (A u)‖ + ‖A u - P (A u)‖
NuclearBoundR88G.convolution_after_projection_off_diagonal.{u_1} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
  (A P : E →L[ℂ] E) (hinvariant : P.comp (A.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - P)) = 0) :
  A.comp P = P.comp A + (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - P).comp (A.comp P)
NuclearBoundR88G.logWeight_translate_bound (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (d : ℕ) (h x : ℝ) :
  logWeight α d (h + x) ≤ Real.exp (2 * α * |h|) * (2 * (1 + h ^ 2)) ^ d * logWeight α d x
NuclearBoundR88G.stripWeight_translate_bound (α s : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (h x : ℝ) :
  stripWeight α s (h + x) ≤ Real.exp (2 * α * |h|) * (2 * (1 + h ^ 2)) ^ (s / 2) * stripWeight α s x
NuclearBoundR88G.stripWeight_energy_bound.{u_2} {X : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (α s : ℝ)
  (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (h : ℝ) (ℓ : X → ℝ) (u : X → ℂ)
  (hi : Integrable (fun x => ‖u x‖ ^ 2 * stripWeight α s (h + ℓ x)) μ)
  (hb : Integrable (fun x => ‖u x‖ ^ 2 * stripWeight α s (ℓ x)) μ) :
  ∫ (x : X), ‖u x‖ ^ 2 * stripWeight α s (h + ℓ x) ∂μ ≤
    Real.exp (2 * α * |h|) * (2 * (1 + h ^ 2)) ^ (s / 2) * ∫ (x : X), ‖u x‖ ^ 2 * stripWeight α s (ℓ x) ∂μ
NuclearBoundR88G.stripWeight_shift_integrable.{u_2} {X : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (α s : ℝ)
  (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (h : ℝ) (ℓ : X → ℝ) (u : X → ℂ)
  (hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => ‖u x‖ ^ 2 * stripWeight α s (h + ℓ x)) μ)
  (hb : Integrable (fun x => ‖u x‖ ^ 2 * stripWeight α s (ℓ x)) μ) :
  Integrable (fun x => ‖u x‖ ^ 2 * stripWeight α s (h + ℓ x)) μ

NuclearBoundR88G.finite_biorthogonal_cost_lower_bound.{u_1, u_2} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
